motto: Opportunities exist. Finding the way should not be difficult.
question: What are you looking for today?
intro: Find an option. Understand the conditions. Take the next step.

goalDescriptions.employment: Find where to look for work.

coverage: Peru, the United States, Mexico, Colombia and Spain. Plus opportunities with international access.
noCountry: No verified content for this selection. We do not substitute another country’s rules.
howTitle: From discovery to your next step
howText: Choose an opportunity, check its conditions and save it to My Route. Then you can mark steps, add tasks and take your preparation with you.
privacy: No UMBRAL account. Your route stays in this browser. Do not include personal data.
disclaimer: UMBRAL provides guidance: it does not submit applications or decide whether you qualify. The institution confirms conditions and outcomes.
catalogIntro: Specific opportunities with requirements, dates and official access.
regionHelp: Scope indicates the place or territory served. National opportunities may still have their own residency requirements.
noResults: No verified opportunities match these filters. Remove a filter or try another category. Closed calls only appear when selected under Availability.
noDeadline: No overall deadline is published. Confirm availability, places and any individual deadlines before proceeding.
stale: This information needs a new review. Confirm its current status with the official source before proceeding.
save: Save this opportunity to My Route
saveExplainer: Saves the opportunity and its preparation steps in this browser; it does not submit an application.
externalNote: Registration and applications take place on the institution’s portal. Do not share documents or passwords with UMBRAL.
documentaryNote: Checked against information published by the institution. This does not confirm service, places or an individual outcome.
routeIntro: Your saved opportunities and the next step for each one.
emptyRoute: Your route starts with an opportunity. Discover an option and save it to organise your steps.
progressNote: The marks reflect your preparation. They are not an application, approval or eligibility assessment.
taskLabel: An action you want to prepare
taskHint: Up to 140 characters. Write actions, without names, documents or personal data.
taskLimit: You can add up to 30 tasks per opportunity.
confirmRemove: Remove this opportunity and its saved steps from My Route?
printError: Could not open printing. Allow pop-up windows or download your preparation.
storageUnavailable: This browser cannot save your route. You can use it during this visit and download it before leaving.
officialDates: Published official dates; check the source for changes.
notFound: We could not find that opportunity
notFoundText: The link may be incorrect or the opportunity is not published. Return to the catalogue for verified options.
catalogReview: Content reviewed on 11 November 2026. Past deadlines close automatically and records without a recent review stop appearing as available.
clearCountryFilters: Changing country resets the other filters.
complementaryNote: These portals help you keep looking; they are not vacancies and do not replace the opportunities above.
countryMeaning: Country indicates the location or scope of an opportunity. It does not assess your nationality or guarantee eligibility.
notAvailable: This option is not available for new applications. Check its status and official source.
localShort: Only in this browser, without an account.
routeCountries: Your route can include multiple countries. Each opportunity keeps its jurisdiction and conditions.
nextPrepared: Preparation marked. Review the opportunity to continue officially.
